subject: Uptick & Onboarding Calendar: Milestone-based Commit Plan
messages:
From: Samantha Li <samantha@fictive-retail.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@fictive-retail.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff and timeline — Fictive Retail evaluation

Evelyn — thanks again for the product demo yesterday. The team liked the latency profile and the cost modeling you showed. We want to move from an exploratory eval to a concrete onboarding calendar so we can align procurement and our platform team.

High-level asks from our side:
- A 6-month activation calendar with clear monthly TPM (tokens/month) targets and corresponding pricing tiers/discounts.
- An initial 30-day evaluation window with a 1-month credit and performance SLOs (99th pct latency target).
- Milestone-based credits or price adjustments at months 2 and 4 if we hit adoption thresholds.

Can you share a draft MAP and SOW we can circulate? Procurement (cc Tom) will need the billing cadence and PO instructions.

Best,
Samantha Li
Head of AI, Fictive Retail
---
Attachments: none

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@fictive-retail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@fictive-retail.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: RE: MAP kickoff and timeline — Fictive Retail evaluation

Thanks Samantha — appreciate the clarity. I attached a first-pass MAP (MAP_v1.pdf) and a pricing workbook that ties monthly TPM to unit pricing (redwood-pricing-2026.xlsx). Quick summary of the proposal below:

- Pilot (Month 0): 30-day eval, $15k credit applied to first invoice, target throughput 2M tokens/month to validate latency and prefix caching benefits.
- Ramp (Months 1–3): 5M -> 10M -> 18M tokens/month. Pricing tier: $0.0022/token base; 10% uplift discount at 10M TPM, additional 5% at 18M TPM.
- Commit (Months 4–6): target steady-state 25M TPM; committed rate $0.0018/token if month-over-month adoption meets agreed milestones.
- Milestone credits: month 2 (reach 10M TPM) triggers $10k account credit; month 4 (reach 18M) triggers $15k credit or equivalent invoice discount.

Open items: exact SLA language, invoice cadence (monthly vs quarterly prepay), and whether Fictive wants a usage true-up. I also included a draft SOW for onboarding tasks and responsibilities.

If that structure looks good I can: 1) incorporate procurement's billing preferences into the SOW, and 2) route the final MAP for signature (DocuSign).

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: MAP_v1.pdf; redwood-pricing-2026.xlsx; SOW-draft.docx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: (none)
Date: 2026-08-15T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: MAP kickoff and timeline — pricing nuance

Evelyn — quick internal note on pricing/timing: the $0.0018 committed rate at 25M TPM is aggressive but doable if we lock a 12-month contractual minimum and agree a quarterly usage review. Suggest adding an automatic fallback to on-demand pricing if monthly TPM drops below 12M for two consecutive months. Also recommend we keep the month 0 credit but require a simple success criteria checklist (latency, error rate, integration completion) to avoid credit misuse.

I'll be available for the call tomorrow to walk through the spreadsheet with Samantha and Tom. If procurement wants net-30 invoicing we should confirm with finance; otherwise recommend monthly invoicing with 30-day payment terms.

-Ben
VP Sales | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: (none)
Date: 2026-08-16T08:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RE: MAP kickoff and timeline — onboarding milestones

Evelyn — two operational asks to include in the MAP:
1) Clear acceptance criteria for each milestone (SLA numbers, integration tasks, and two sample production prompts to validate quality).
2) A rollback policy: if performance regressions cause an outage we offer a one-time remediation credit and temporary reduced throughput until the fix is applied.

Also propose we add an onboarding checkpoint at day 14 (integration review) and day 45 (post-pilot performance review). Those checkpoints will gate the milestone credits.

-Marissa

- We prefer quarterly invoicing with a 30-day net. Is there a volume discount for quarterly prepay?
- Need the final SOW with billing contact and invoice remit address to issue a PO.
- Please include a line in the SOW for data handling (logs retention, encryption at rest), otherwise our legal team will redline.

We can turn a PO within 7 business days once the SOW and MAP pricing tables are final.

Tom — thanks for the procurement notes. I've updated the SOW to include billing contact, remit address, and a short data handling appendix (logs retention: 90 days by default; encryption at rest: AES-256). For quarterly prepay we can offer a 3% uplift discount on unit price if Fictive prepays for a quarter and commits to the forecasted TPM for that quarter. That option is reflected in the attached pricing workbook.

- Coordinate a 30-minute signoff call on Friday 8/20 to finalize billing cadence and DocuSign routing.

Evelyn

Summary of agreed activation calendar (for the record):
- Pilot (month 0): 30-day eval, 2M TPM target, $15k credit applied to Q1 prepay.
- Ramp: Month 1 = 5M TPM, Month 2 = 10M TPM (triggers $10k credit), Month 3 = 18M TPM (triggers $15k credit).

Please send the final invoice schedule and onboarding checklist so our platform team can schedule the integration sprint. Looking forward to a smooth activation.

Best,
